overview.sectorTag: Village & Panchayat Development • Agriculture & Rural Economy
overview.title: Drain Plus
overview.headline: Detect Blockages Early. Prevent Flooding Before It Starts.
overview.subheading: An affordable, compact, ESP32-powered robotic rover designed to inspect narrow stormwater drains, identify waste and blockages, monitor rising water levels, and transmit real-time alerts to a web dashboard over Wi-Fi.
overview.missionDesc: In rural panchayats and suburban zones, blocked roadside culverts choke silently with plastic waste and silt. Manual inspection is slow and hazardous. Drain Plus provides student-buildable, low-cost robotics that gives village authorities early warnings before heavy monsoon downpours turn minor clogs into disastrous inundations.
overview.indicativeNotice: These are indicative component prices in India; verify current prices before purchasing.
overview.technicalAccuracyBody: Sensor measurements and water depths in this dashboard originate from controlled test setups and simulation algorithms. Field deployment in raw monsoon conditions requires protected, submersible sensors rather than unsealed hobby modules.

matrix.title: Drain Plus Prioritization Matrix & Rules
matrix.subtitle: Explainable Culvert Triage & Maintenance Ranking Framework
matrix.desc: Drain Plus employs transparent, multi-factor rule scoring to calculate immediate clearance priorities for incoming rover telemetry and citizen hazard alerts.
matrix.humanLivesDesc: 15 pts per stranded citizen (capped at 50 pts). Immediate priority override if children or elderly identified.
matrix.depthDesc: ≥1.5m (+35 pts, extreme drowning & vehicle washout); ≥0.9m (+25 pts); ≥0.4m (+15 pts).
matrix.electricalDesc: Submerged transformers, live sparking lines, or grid junction breach. Mandatory power isolation protocol.
matrix.flowDesc: Flow speed >1.5 m/s sweeps pedestrians; submerged vehicles obstructing critical hospital or evacuation corridors.

public.safetyRules: Essential Storm-Drain Safety Rules for Citizens
public.do1: Clear domestic trash away from roadside storm culverts.
public.do2: Keep phone charged, emergency flashlight, and drinking water ready.
public.do3: Report clogged agricultural canals to your local village panchayat officer.
public.do4: Follow verified updates on this Drain Plus portal.
public.dont1: DO NOT drive or walk into flooded subway underpasses.
public.dont2: DO NOT touch metal poles or transformers standing in water.
public.dont3: DO NOT drink tap water without boiling during flood periods.
public.dont4: DO NOT spread unverified social media rumors.

judgeTour.title: Drain Plus — Interactive Platform Demo Tour
judgeTour.subtitle: AquaBots • Smart Storm-Drain Inspection Platform
judgeTour.welcome: Welcome to the Drain Plus interactive tour. You can test each core pillar of our smart storm-drain inspection platform with the 1-click interactive triggers below:
judgeTour.step1Desc: Fires an autonomous optical scan, triggers prioritization rule engine, updates map & logs sound alert.
judgeTour.step2Desc: Opens full disaster SOP modal, assigns SDRF boat squad, logs dispatch notes & copies SITREP.
judgeTour.step3Desc: Inspect the scoring formula (Water depth, Trapped lives, Electrical hazards, Flow speed).
judgeTour.step4Heading: Switch to Public Safety & Shelter View
judgeTour.step4Desc: Explore verified relief camps, emergency helplines, and test the public hazard submission form.
judgeTour.step5Desc: Fires an audio alarm (Web Audio API) and pushes a high-priority red alert to the notification center.
